voxymap.config.comment.1: Automatically regenerate the map when the player moves far away or after the initial delay
voxymap.config.comment.2: Refresh once the player moved this many chunks since the last update
voxymap.config.comment.3: Refresh once this many minutes after joining a world (0 disables the initial refresh)
voxymap.config.comment.5: Map resolution: blocks per pixel (1 = sharpest and slowest, 4 = coarse and fast)
voxymap.config.comment.6: Highest Voxy LOD level to merge (0-4). Lower values skip far coarse data
voxymap.config.comment.7: Read the sea level from the world (adapts to terrain mods)
voxymap.config.comment.8: Sea level used when autoSeaLevel is disabled
voxymap.config.comment.10: Default palette: current, gradient, gmt, nautical, gradient-turbo, gradient-soft
voxymap.config.comment.12: Drop contour fragments smaller than this many pixels
voxymap.config.comment.15: Initial zoom when opening the map
voxymap.config.comment.16: Stretch the land colour ramp to the world's actual height range
voxymap.config.comment.17: Blur the water depth to smooth out sea-floor speckles
voxymap.config.comment.18: Water blur radius in map pixels
voxymap.config.comment.20: Remove isolated height outliers on land
voxymap.config.comment.21: Fill small interior data holes with the local median
voxymap.config.comment.23: Show cursor coordinates at the bottom of the screen
voxymap.config.comment.24: Show the control hint in the top-left corner
voxymap.config.comment.25: Offer the teleport entry in the right-click menu
voxymap.config.comment.26: Land only: sea level (green) up to the map's highest point (white); water colours are unchanged
voxymap.config.landMaxRamp: Stretch land palette to map's highest point
voxymap.config.comment.27: How many contour lines span the land height range (higher = denser)
